violations.why: irq_acorn (equal priority) can preempt irq_ridge between its write and the check, changing v_harbor.
irq_ridge can preempt irq_acorn between its writes and read the intermediate value of v_harbor.
irq_acorn can write v_wharf between irq_ridge's write and its later read in fn_cobalt.
irq_acorn can write v_velvet between the two reads in fn_maple called from irq_ridge.
irq_acorn (higher priority) can preempt irq_north and overwrite v_quill[9000] between its write and read.
